issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfInscribedStudents as type int, but the solution implementation declares numberOfInscribedStudents as long (and the constructor accepts a long). This type mismatch will cause confusion about the expected type and leads to a compilation/runtime issue when summing inscribed and guest students (long + int) while some methods are declared to return int.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfInscribedStudents consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution to use int for numberOfInscribedStudents (update the field, constructor parameter, getter/setter) to match the UML/problem statement, or update the UML/problem statement to declare numberOfInscribedStudents as long. Also ensure getTotalNumberOfStudents and any methods that sum these fields use a consistent return type (int if both operands are int, or long if using long) to avoid implicit narrowing/compilation errors.
